newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia police break up protest against Israel.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia police break up protest against Israel.

text.p: Malaysian riot police on Friday fired teargas canisters and turned water cannon on demonstrators opposed to the presence of an Israeli cricket team in the predominantly Moslem country, witnesses said.

The demonstrators from the opposition Malaysia Islamic Party, known by its initials in Malay as PAS, shouted "Crush the Jews" and "Long live Islam" at Malaya University, where a match between Israel and Argentina was to take place.
The match had been moved to another undisclosed venue before the demonstrators arrived.

Police used the water cannon to disperse about 500 people at the university, many of whom fled into a nearby mosque. Some remained outside throwing stones at several dozen policemen in riot gear, a Reuters Television correspondent said.

The Israeli cricket team, taking part in the 22-nation International Cricket Council Trophy tournament, was the first official delegation of any sort from the country to come to Malaysia, which does not have diplomatic ties with Israel.

Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said on Friday that the government had allowed the Israel team to visit to "show them (Israelis) that Muslims in Malaysia can be an example to other Islamic countries".
